observations.body: Children, parents, slaves, and masters hear household commands. Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

payload.posture: Read Ephesians 6:1–9 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states children, parents, slaves, and masters hear household commands. Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right. You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
